vocabulary.meaning_en: be born in or live in a place

vocabulary.note_en: Country names start with a capital letter.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a time when you rest and travel, not work
vocabulary.example: We went to the sea for our vacation.
We had a lot of fun at the park.

with a hot, strong taste (like chili)
be able to deal with something
vocabulary.note_ar: I can handle it = أستطيع تحمّله
vocabulary.example: Can you handle a lot of work?

vocabulary.meaning_en: remain in a place for some time

fine_lines.title: come from vs be from
fine_lines.explanation_ar: المعنى واحد: I come from Japan = I'm from Japan. لاحظ: مع come نستخدم do في السؤال (Where do you come from?) ومع be نستخدم are (Where are you from?).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Both mean the same. Questions: Where do you come from? / Where are you from?

fine_lines.title: work as vs work for
fine_lines.explanation_ar: work as + المهنة (a teacher). work for + الشركة أو جهة العمل (a company).
fine_lines.explanation_en: work as + a job. work for + a company.

examples.sentence: I work for a software company.

expressions.meaning_en: A friendly question when you meet someone.

expressions.phrase: I'm fine, thank you. And you?
expressions.meaning_en: A polite answer to "How are you?".
expressions.example: I'm fine, thank you. And you?

expressions.meaning_en: Ask about someone's country or city.
expressions.example: Where are you from? I'm from Oman.

expressions.meaning_en: Say politely that you don't like something much.
expressions.example: I'm not a fan of cold weather.

expressions.meaning_en: Ask the reason for a visit.
expressions.example: Why did you come here? I came for work.

expressions.meaning_en: Ask if someone is enjoying the moment.
expressions.example: Are you having fun at the park?

expressions.meaning_en: Say you are enjoying something very much.
expressions.example: Thanks for inviting me. I'm having a great time.

expressions.phrase: How much longer will you stay here?
expressions.meaning_en: Ask how much more time someone will stay.
expressions.example: How much longer will you stay here? Two more days.

expressions.meaning_en: Ask about someone's job or workplace.
expressions.example: Where do you work? At a hospital.

expressions.meaning_en: Ask the other person the same question.
expressions.example: I'm a student. What about you?

grammar.title: Present simple questions with "do"
grammar.explanation_ar: نسأل عن الحقائق والعادات بالمضارع البسيط: Where do you work? / Do you like spicy food? نضع do قبل الفاعل، والفعل يبقى في أصله. والجواب: I work... / Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
grammar.explanation_en: Use the present simple for facts and habits. Question: (Wh-word) + do + you + verb? Answer: I work... / Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
examples: Where do you work? I work at a school.
Do you like the local cuisine? Yes, I do.
Do you like animation? No, I don't.

grammar.title: Past simple for a finished action
grammar.explanation_ar: للحديث عن حدث انتهى في الماضي نستخدم الماضي البسيط. come فعل شاذ: ماضيه came. في السؤال نستخدم did والفعل في أصله: Why did you come here? والجواب: I came for vacation.
grammar.explanation_en: For finished past actions use the past simple. "Come" is irregular: came. Question: Why did you come? Answer: I came for vacation.

grammar.title: Future with "will"
grammar.explanation_ar: للحديث عن خطة أو قرار في المستقبل نستخدم will + الفعل في أصله: I will stay for one more week. I will return home.
grammar.explanation_en: Use will + base verb to talk about the future.
examples: I will stay for one more week.

grammar.title: Present continuous: "Are you having fun?"
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم am/is/are + فعل ينتهي بـ ing للحديث عن شيء يحدث الآن: Are you having fun? I'm having a great time.
grammar.explanation_en: Use am/is/are + verb-ing for things happening now.
examples: Yes, I'm having a great time.
We are visiting the old city now.

questions.question: Where are you from? — I ___ from Japan.
questions.explanation_ar: مع I نستخدم come بدون s في المضارع.

questions.question: What does "delicious" mean?
questions.explanation_en: Delicious means it tastes very good.

questions.question: Choose the correct answer: "How are you?"
questions.explanation_ar: الرد المناسب على How are you هو I'm fine, thank you.
questions.explanation_en: "I'm fine, thank you" answers "How are you?".

questions.question: Why did you come here? — I ___ for vacation.
questions.explanation_en: The question is in the past, so answer with "came".

questions.question: I work ___ a teacher at a local school.
I work ___ a software development company.

How much longer will you stay? — I ___ for one more week.
questions.explanation_ar: السؤال عن المستقبل بـ will، فالجواب: I will stay.
questions.explanation_en: It's about the future: I will stay.

questions.question: Is the food too ___ for you? — No, I enjoy hot food.
Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم Are you مع a قبل المهنة: Are you a software engineer?
questions.explanation_en: Use "Are you" and "a" before the job.
